annotations.title: x402 preflight: inspect a paid endpoint before paying

description: Sends an unpaid GET to an x402 endpoint and reports what it would charge before paying: HTTP status, redirects (max 3, re-validated), v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or v1 body challenge and its validity, each accepts entry (scheme, CAIP-2 network/name, atomic amount, USD for canonical USDC, asset check, payTo, timeout, EIP-712 name/version), OFAC SDN payTo screen, resource, Bazaar extension, risk flags, host context from registry RDAP (registrar, domain age) and Cloudflare DoH. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

url.description: https:// URL of the x402 endpoint, including any query string, up to 2048 characters. Default port only; no embedded credentials, IP-address hosts, localhost or private names.
